feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 25 August 2026 10:12pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 25 August 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Occasionally strong wind for a time tonight.


##Synopsis##

High pressure centred over the Norwegian Sea with a shallow slow-moving low in sea area Plymouth.


##Wind##

East 4 to 6, decreasing 4 or 5 by the morning, then 3 or 4 in the afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate becoming slight tomorrow afternoon.


##Weather##

Occasional rain slowly spreading across the area from the southwest overnight and tomorrow. Becoming mainly fair later in the evening.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, occasionally moderate in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or northeast 3 or 4, occasionally 5 in places, backing north or northeast 2 to 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Mostly slight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, then rain developing Thursday afternoon, heavy in places.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.
